---
name: incident-dashboard
description: "Incident Dashboard feature — state, architecture, known issues, what's deferred"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: f97c48c7-798b-4110-96b6-1a72f38dd5a3
---

Full CRUD dashboard for security incidents generated by AI (FR = Facial Recognition, OD = Object Detection) or manually by FM staff.

**Files:**
- `client/src/pages/IncidentDashboard.jsx` — React component, all CRUD logic
- `client/src/css/IncidentDashboard.css` — all styles (badges, cards, toasts, animations)
- `server/routes/incident.js` — Express routes (POST /, GET /, GET /:id, PATCH /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /scan-frame)
- `server/models/IncidentLog.js` — Sequelize model, `paranoid: true` (soft delete)

**Route guard:** `ACCESS.FM_ONLY` in App.jsx, isFM block in Sidebar.jsx

**Model columns:** camera_location, status (detection type e.g. UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS), person_name, confidence_score, severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), source (Facial Recognition/Object Detection/Manual), resolutionStatus (Active/Investigating/Escalated to Security/Cleared), notes

**Seed:** 12 static incidents seeded once on first load, gated by localStorage flag `flowguard_incidents_seeded`. All seed incidents start with resolutionStatus='Active'.

**Filters:** Client-side on the fetched data — search (person+location), severity, source, resolutionStatus.

**Animations:** 
- Row slide-in (`.inc-row-new`): new rows after create
- Row slide-out (`.inc-row-deleting`): 350ms animation, then removed from state
- Toast stack: `.incToastEnter`/`.incToastExit` animations using max-height trick for natural document-flow push

**Toast system:** `toasts` array state, `toastCounterRef` for IDs, 3s timer per toast, types: success (green), delete (red), error (amber). Stacked in document flow between filter bar and table.

**Back-to-top:** Scroll listener on `mainRef.current` (dashboard-main div), not window. Position calculated from getBoundingClientRect for horizontal centering.

**Table truncation:** 30 chars for location + person name, full text in title tooltip and detail modal.

**DEFERRED (not implemented):**
- Live data seeding from AI scan-frame into the dashboard
- No changes to any other page

**How to apply:** Live AI integration route exists (`POST /scan-frame`) but the frontend dashboard doesn't subscribe to it — it only shows manually created + seeded data.
